candidate.definition_en: To hold on tightly to someone or something, or to stick closely to a surface.
candidate.explanation_ar: يتشبث أو يمسك في شخص أو شيء بقوة، أو يلتصق بسطح ما.

senses.definition_en: To hold on tightly to someone or something physically or emotionally.
senses.definition_ar: يتشبث أو يتمسك بشدة بشخص أو فكرة أو أمل.
examples: Traditionalists cling to the old customs despite modern changes.
In times of crisis, people often cling to hope.

senses.definition_en: To stick or adhere closely to a surface or material.
senses.definition_ar: يلتصق بإحكام بسطح أو جسم ما.
examples: Wet clothes cling to the body.
Wet clothes cling to the body.
Traditionalists cling to the old customs despite modern changes.
In times of crisis, people often cling to hope.
